_provenance.notes: Alaska's limited entry permit system, established under AS 16.43 (1973), assigns a fixed number of entry permits for each fishery. Permit market values reflect fishery profitability expectations. Key permit series: F1A (Bristol Bay drift gillnet), F1E (Kenai/Cook Inlet drift gillnet), S01A (Bristol Bay beach seine), S09B (Prince William Sound drift gillnet), E10H (Bering Sea red king crab), E10K (Bering Sea snow crab bairdi).
